originality.rationale: The new exact seven-stratum ordered fiber count was compared against the classical existence/cyclic-symmetrizer theorem, congruence and numerical symmetrization literature, nearest published indexed factorization results, and accessible own historical claims. Existing intertwiners determine only nonsingular-first-factor counts; the singular rank-one and zero target fibers require additional arguments. No dominating table identified. Historical priority remains provisional, especially for one abstract-only 1981 source.

value.rationale: Classical symmetric factorization proves surjectivity but does not quantify nonuniqueness. The complete target-by-target multiplicity law for the first nontrivial matrix dimension, all prime powers, all seven target strata, and target-stratum multiplicities is a motivated natural enumeration; it quantitatively separates singular and rational-canonical-form behaviors, not merely a chosen numerical instance.
